title: New inventory rejection reason added
query: What breaks across repositories if inventory.reservation-rejected gains a new EXPIRED reason alongside OUT_OF_STOCK?

affected_repositories.name: inventory-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: owns InventoryService.emit of inventory.reservation-rejected with the reason payload

affected_repositories.name: order-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: saga consumes the rejection to drive REJECTED_OUT_OF_STOCK; an unknown reason needs explicit handling

affected_repositories.name: commerce-web
affected_repositories.evidence_note: order status display renders the rejection reason to the user

notes: Schema addition, not a rename: the discriminator for tools that only detect breaking renames. Consumers that switch exhaustively on the reason need a new arm; consumers that ignore unknown reasons stay green and must not be reported.
